en: Product ideas, New product trials, Sample feedback and Waitlist run new products from the first idea to the launch: expected margin, trial sell-through (units sold as a share of units made), tester scores and customers waiting.
mt: 产品创意、新产品试用、反馈样本 和 Waitlist 运行新产品从第一个想法到发布的整个过程：预期利润、试用销售率（销售量占生产量的比例）、测试人员分数和等待的客户。
